[[File:Ad-series-SGtD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An AD-series armorer droid]]
An '''armorer droid''' was a kind of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designed to repair weaponry and military gear. It had extensive knowledge about weapons. Models of these droids included Arakyd's [[AD-series weapons maintenance droid]] and the exclusive [[House Paramexor Squire Armorer Droid]].
